b_motion: Before cut: Camera moves in a flatter, less dynamic diagonal path.
After cut: Camera translates linearly down-right over the three buttons with robotic, constant velocity.

differences.a_does: Uses a dynamic, tight isometric angle with telephoto compression.
differences.b_does: Uses a flatter, wider, more top-down camera perspective.

differences.a_does: Features high-contrast directional key light casting distinct, soft shadows.
differences.b_does: Features flat, uniform ambient lighting with barely visible shadows.
differences.fix: Add a strong directional key light from the top-right and reduce ambient fill by 40%.

differences.a_does: Applies smooth, organic ease-in/ease-out curves to camera translation.
differences.b_does: Applies linear, robotic interpolation to camera keyframes.
differences.fix: Adjust camera translation keyframes to use Bezier easing with 60% influence.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera angle and focal length to match the tight, dynamic isometric perspective of the reference film.

Cards remain static and flat against the background grid.

differences.a_does: Smooth, sweeping camera path with organic easing and a tight, dynamic perspective.
